name: Avant USD
oneLiner: avUSD is Avant's centralized dollar stablecoin, redeemable 1:1 for USDC and deployed into actively managed market-neutral strategies for yield.
collateral: avUSD is fully backed 1:1 by USDC and is the non-yield-bearing, 1:1-redeemable receipt for deposited USDC. The actively managed market-neutral strategies (basis trades, lending-rate arbitrage, yield trading, lending markets, liquidity provisioning, and private liquidity deals) generate yield that accrues to the staked savUSD senior tranche, with the avUSDx junior tranche and a dedicated avUSD Reserve Fund absorbing strategy losses ahead of savUSD; avUSD holders themselves receive no yield
pegMechanism: 1:1 redemption for USDC via Avant Protocol with a 0.05% redemption fee and 1–7 day settlement window; avUSD itself receives no yield, while staking into the separate savUSD token is the yield-bearing route

applicabilityBasis.summary: avUSD is the non-yield Avant base token backed 1:1 by USDC and redeemable through protocol mint/redeem flows.

genius.notes: avUSD has stablecoin-like reserve and redemption disclosures; no public GENIUS approval or foreign-issuer exception source was found. Terms of Use (avantprotocol.com) govern under BVI law and refer to 'Avant Protocol Foundation and its affiliates' as the operating entity; company profiles list Palo Alto, CA as operational HQ but no US legal entity name is disclosed. BVI domicile retained as primary; issuerPathway kept unknown pending clearer entity structure disclosure.

controls.label: Avant Protocol operations backend (MPC + policy engine)
controls.evidence: Avant secures privileged operations through MPC wallets (Fireblocks/Fordefi), a transaction policy engine, role-based access control, and address whitelisting; no public Safe/multisig threshold for the minter role is disclosed.
